home.title: Cross-platform file sharing with ease
home.subtitle: dropX sends photos, videos, music, documents and apps straight between your devices over local Wi-Fi or a device hotspot. No cables, no cloud, no internet connection.
feature.cross_platform.title: Cross-platform
feature.cross_platform.body: Android, iOS, Windows, macOS and Linux all talk to each other.
feature.no_internet.title: No Internet Required
feature.no_internet.body: Transfers stay on your local network. No mobile data used.
feature.private.title: Private & Direct
feature.private.body: Files go device-to-device. Nothing is uploaded to a server.
feature.any_file.title: Any File Type
feature.any_file.body: Photos, videos, music, documents and Android apps (APK).
feature.hotspot.title: Wi-Fi or Hotspot
feature.hotspot.body: Use your router, or connect two devices directly with a hotspot.
feature.verified.title: Verified Transfers
feature.verified.body: Every chunk is integrity-checked so what arrives matches what was sent.
feature.auth.title: Peer Authentication
feature.auth.body: Both screens show a short verification code. If they match, nobody is listening in between — and every transfer needs the receiver's approval first.
feature.chunks.title: No Chunk Left Behind
feature.chunks.body: Every chunk is acknowledged the moment it lands, and each finished file is verified, so a transfer only completes when every last byte is accounted for.
